quotes.speaker: Jalen Duren
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Duren on the mental discipline required for an early NBA entry
quotes.excerpt: You just got to be mentally ready. You got to understand that, especially when you get to the NBA
quotes.quote: You just got to be mentally ready. You got to understand that, especially when you get to the NBA or you get to the next level, or you really just get in the real world, it's no longer a kid game. You no longer look at as a kid when you're in a grown man's business. Having your mind right and understanding that and approaching everything with a grown man like mindset will help you go a long way.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Duren
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Duren on Tobias Harris's leadership and impact on the team
quotes.excerpt: He was a guy who took on a role of being the older guy and giving back
quotes.quote: One person that up top of my head would be Tobias Harris. He was with us. He was a guy who took on a role of being the older guy and giving back, whether it be on the court or off the court information. He's willing to educate guys, so he was a guy who, and he wasn't the only one, but he was just the most recent that I can think of that really kind of poured into everybody.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Duren
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Duren on the importance of culture and brotherhood in team success
quotes.excerpt: Those are the teams that go the furthest, the teams that build a brotherhood, build a culture
quotes.quote: Those are the best teams. Those are the teams that go the furthest, the teams that build a brotherhood, build a culture, better understanding of how you're going to attack that game and attack every obstacle together. I think we built a culture in Detroit that has kind of been here, and we were able to build on past teams, past energies, and kind of continue that culture. So I think culture, a brotherhood is what takes you far.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Duren
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Duren's advice to young leaders on maintaining their own path
quotes.excerpt: Never let nobody tell you you're too young.
quotes.quote: I would say to the young leaders, never let nobody tell you you're too young.
